name: Seatruck Fish Scoop BZ
description: Adds a new craftable Sea Truck upgrade module to the workbench: the 'SeaTruck Fish Scoop'! When enabled, hitting small fish will automatically add them to any attached aquarium modules, instead of killing them.

media.label: Creating the upgrade in the fabricator
Installing the upgrade in the Seatruck

faq.question: How do I install?
faq.answer: Use the OpenMods Manager or extract the zip into your game folder.
